Volcano plots (EnhancedVolcano) of FragPipe-Analyst differential abundance results.

**Input:** `DE_results.csv` (FragPipe-Analyst).
**Note:** taken from the 2025-10-19 analysis (`NUCL_HSLiver_HepG2_HCT116_FANCI_DDAplus_20251019`). Example comparison: GFP-NPM1 vs NPM1 antibody NuFANCI sort.


```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# setwd("path/to/data")  # folder with DE_results.csv (FragPipe-Analyst)
library(tidyverse)
library(EnhancedVolcano)
```

```{r}
DE_results = read.csv("DE_results.csv")
```

```{r fig.height=6, fig.width=6}
p1 <- EnhancedVolcano(DE_results,
    lab = DE_results$Gene.Name,
    x = 'NUCL_GFPNPM1_AB_FANCI_vs_NUCL_NPM1_AB_FANCI_log2.fold.change',
    y = 'NUCL_GFPNPM1_AB_FANCI_vs_NUCL_NPM1_AB_FANCI_p.adj',
    title = 'GFP-NPM1 vs NPM1 antibody NuFANCI',
    subtitle = NULL,
    caption = NULL,
    titleLabSize = 10,
    pCutoff = 0.05,
    FCcutoff = 1,
    pointSize = 1.0,
    labSize = 3,
    arrowheads = FALSE,
    col = c('gray50', 'gray50', 'gray50', 'gray50'),
    colAlpha = 1,
    axisLabSize = 10,
    drawConnectors = T,
    widthConnectors = 0.75,
    legendPosition = 'top',
    legendLabSize = 8,
    legendIconSize = 2.0,
    border = 'full',
    boxedLabels = F)
p1
```
